texts.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向[target.GetName]重大灾难。
texts.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw towards the [target.GetName].

texts.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组，他们将设法把[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]引诱至[target.GetAdj]领土上。预计将全队覆灭。
texts.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives who will seek to lure the [crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName] directly into [target.GetAdj] territory. The team is not expected to return.

texts.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]这次报告道，没有危机级别威胁被这样一次行动引诱到。[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]所召集到的特工将保持待命，直到我们对这个肆虐整个星系的毁灭灾厄有了更进一步的了解。
texts.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that at this time, no crisis-level threats are likely to be lured in by such an operation. The operatives [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] assembled will remain on standby until we know more about the catastrophic threats lurking in this galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们在[target.GetName]附近的特工们发出了一条单方面通讯：他们已经准备好继续执行任务，一但我们发出指令，他们就将去触怒[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。
texts.en: Our operatives near the [target.GetName] have sent a one-time communiqué: they are ready to proceed, and will draw the ire of the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName] upon our signal.

texts.zh:
我们的研究者只能假设我方特工迅速而见机行事的思路奏了效，因为他们成功地引诱了一艘来自肃正协议威胁的舰队。无论是通过精妙的骇入协议，亦或是通过伪造某种形式的漏洞超载，我们的遥测扫描已经确认[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]之间传来了敌对的信号传输。

无论[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]在这个纷乱的时间点是否还有其他的顾虑：我们的行动保证他们至少又多了一件事可以操碎他们的心。
texts.en:
Our researchers can only speculate upon the quick and adaptive thinking employed by our operatives when they successfully lured a fleet from the ongoing Contingency threat. Whether by an elaborate protocol hacking or by fabricating some sort of loophole override, our remote scans now confirm a hostile presence in transit between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName].

Whether or not the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] have other ongoing concerns during these turbulent times: our actions have ensured they shall have at least one more pressing matter to attend to.

texts.zh:
尽管他们最近表现得很团结，[raider_khanate.GetName]最后还是证明了自己只是头脑简单的猎捕者，轻易就被愤怒钓上了钩。我们的小队想方设法激怒了某位指挥官，后者正甚嚣尘上地以超光速杀向[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]。

我们的特工很确信任何倒霉到竖立在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]之间的恒星基地都会作为东道主给这支掠夺者小分队表演一下什么叫做热锅上的蚂蚁。让我们希望这次牺牲没有白费。
texts.en:
Despite their recent attempts at unity, the [raider_khanate.GetName] have proven an uncomplicated prey to bait in anger. Our team worked hard to antagonize one Commander in particular, whose boiling rage is now being directed at faster-than-light speeds toward the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName].

Our operatives are resolute that any starbase unfortunate enough to lie between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will play chaotic host to this small band of marauders. Let us hope this sacrifice is not in vain.

texts.zh:
我们对抗异次元入侵者的努力终于有了成果，尽管代价十分的惨重。我们的特工成功地诱使一支异次元舰队认为他们在[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]领土腹地的一个次元锚正处于威胁。舰队现在正从[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系向[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]开拔。

间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]会继续监视这一形势，但是看样子我们是没法见到我们的特工活着返回了。我们必须密切关注，并相信我们的诱敌方案有利于我们的计划。
texts.en:
Our efforts against the Extradimensional Invaders have paid off, though the cost was certainly steep. Our operatives have successfully duped an extra-dimensional fleet into thinking one of their dimensional anchors is under threat, deep inside [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] territory. Ships are now en route to [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName] from the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system.

Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will continue to monitor the situation, but it is unlikely we will see our operatives returned to us. We must now watch, and trust that our lure serves our plan.

texts.zh:
吸引这个所谓的灰蛊风暴这样零散的实体的注意力，并不是什么难事。我们的特工成功地通过一个单发的、调制的载波成功地把灰蛊风暴指向了[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]。

构建这个波充满挑战，因为[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都之间距离很长，使得[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]需要前所未有的能量维持。我们的团队采用了在一个远程发射器的电源组中触发一个不可控的连锁反应。该装置保持在一起的时间刚好足以将我们的诱饵传送到超空间。

长距离遥测显示纳米虫群正向着[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]前进。我们的研究人员还注意到在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]附近发生了灾难性爆炸，这应该是我们的那位特工的功劳。
texts.en:
Drawing the focused attention of entities as piecemeal as this so-called Gray Tempest was no mean feat. Our operatives succeeded by way of a one-shot, modulating carrier wave pointed squarely in the direction of the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName].

Constructing this wave was a fraught effort, as the distance between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName] requires an unprecedented amount of energy. Our team resorted to triggering an uncontrollable chain reaction in the power banks of a long-range transmitter. The device held together just long enough to beam our lure across hyperspace.

Long-distance telemetry suggests that a Nanite Swarm is now making its way towards the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]. Our researchers also note readings of a catastrophic explosion in the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] - believed to be the site of our operatives' fatal endeavor.

texts.zh:
我们对虫群天灾的生物引擎研究的时间虽然不长，但是被证明十分有效。我们发明了一种合成化合物——生产起来很昂贵，运输起来也很困难——但是能够成功诱使一支舰队偏离虫群。

这种化合物的附着性是如此之强，我方特工的命运现在就和竖在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]之间的恒星基地一样惨烈。一旦我方特工释放这种诱骗性的化合物，他们的命就没了。

相比于四散而逃并搅乱虫群的路线，我们的小队决定花费剩余的时间确保没有留下任何行动的痕迹。[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]很快就会尝到我们的牺牲带来的后果。
texts.en:
Our research into the biological drives of the Prethoryn Scourge was conducted swiftly, but has proven effective. We devised a synthetic compound - expensive to produce, and dangerous to transport - which has succeeded in luring a fleet away from the Swarm.

So adhesive is this compound that the fate of our operatives is now as bleak as that of any starbase which lies between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]. The moment our operatives released the beguiling chemical, their fate was sealed.

Rather than flee and risk confusing the swarm's route, our team will instead spend what remaining time they have ensuring that the trail remains intact. The [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will soon experience the results of our sacrifice.

texts.zh:
我们探测到了来自[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]的敌对信号，正朝着我们的首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]笔直地杀过来！奇怪的能量波动从[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]的附近爆发，我们猜测这是他们的源头。

当这个区域的能量信号突然发生变化时，我们才刚刚开始分析这一现象。所有的信号都显示这是舰队移动突然发生了改变。此外，中间至少有一个能量信号看上去不属于[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。无论他们是谁，看上去正是他们导致了这样的行为。我们怀疑这是我们的某个星系对手搞得祸水东引动作。
texts.en:
We detect a hostile presence from the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName], heading straight for our capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]! Strange energy waves have burst out from the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName], their assumed origin.

We had just begun the work of analyzing this phenomenon when energy signatures in the region abruptly changed. All signs suggest this means a sudden change of fleet movements. Furthermore, at least one of those energy signatures looks to belong to an empire other than the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]. Whoever they are, they appear to be the cause of this behavior. We suspect this to be provocative action by one of our galactic rivals.

summary.text:
# 天灾信标 / Crisis Beacon

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nemesis_operations_events_1.txt, common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家发起“天灾信标”（common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:831-916）：需要正在进行的危机、近期未用过；3个阶段，难度最高（@diff_t8）。
Crisis Beacon needs an ongoing crisis and no recent use; three stages at the highest difficulty.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. operation.4000 “小队待命”：选择要吸引的天灾势力（最多三个）。 Choose which crisis to draw.
2. operation.4001 “前进暗号”：小队出发。 3. operation.4002 “大鱼上钩”：“开始行动！”→ operation.4005：天灾舰队被引向目标国；目标国收到 operation.4010“[舰队]朝首都行动”。
   Launch -> 4005 (the crisis fleet is lured toward the target); the target is warned in 4010.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 4000 的三个目标互斥。 The three targets of 4000 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 失败的检定走“深度潜伏”事件池（扼杀 / 特工叛逃 / 信任危机）。 Failed rolls use the deep-cover pool.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：操作类型与 operation.4000-4010。
